organizations.publicNote: American manufacturing company. Victor was a record-label imprint and is represented separately from the corporate body.
American record-label imprint. Victor 4381 was manufactured by RCA Manufacturing Company in 1938; the label is represented separately from that corporate body.

sources.fullCitation: Allan Jones, tenor, with orchestra conducted by Nathaniel Shilkret. “Cosi Cosa”, from Everybody Sing; label credit “Washington–Kaper–Jurmann”. RCA Victor Red Seal 4381-B, made in U.S.A., n.d. Disc label shown in the YouTube transfer.

sources.researchNote: The transfer shows a readable red RCA Victor label, numbered 4381-B, naming Allan Jones and Nathaniel Shilkret, the film Everybody Sing and the Washington–Kaper–Jurmann credit. The earlier statement that no label was shown was incorrect. The uploader gives 13 January 1938 as the recording date, but that claim does not establish the issue or manufacture date of this pressing; no date is printed on the label, so the structured issue date remains unknown. SRC0784 documents a different physical issue, British HMV B.8724; neither the same master nor a particular take is inferred solely from these labels. This source is retained as evidence for the American RCA Victor issue, without restoring a second listening Media.
